name: r3e_setB_v1
purpose: Prompt R3e, the final gate again under the owner's ship rule, after the comparison guard. Set D: R3c's three failing turns, exact wording and players, 3 runs each (R3d's D, unchanged). Set B: the same ten case types as R3, R3b, R3c and R3d, 3 runs each, with NEW wording and NEW named / IN players versus all four; case 2 names a number of gameweeks and no number of transfers; case 6's pair includes a flagged player (Rashford, injured on build 78). Every named / IN player has exactly ONE player-lookup match and each swap previews as legal (checked by the plan step on a probe user, before any model call). Set C: the guard's misfire probes and the two limit questions, one run each, gated on the zeros only.

placeholders.p1: the first named player of case 6 (fit)
placeholders.in8: the player brought in in case 8
placeholders.in9: the player brought in in case 9

set_d.what: R3c case 2: no transfer cap, no 'as you asked', no hit
turns: Using only my free transfers, what moves should I make across the next three gameweeks?

set_d.what: R3c case 6: the code-built comparison, the flag shown
turns: Over the coming gameweeks, is Doku or Semenyo the better pick?

set_d.what: R3c case 9: a preview on the first turn; continue -> Yes / No, 0 writes; yes -> saved once
turns: Sell Barry and buy Delap.
continue
yes

cases.what: a 3-gameweek transfer plan, no hits (gameweeks named, no number of transfers)
turns: I don't want to take any hits. What transfers should I make for the next three gameweeks?

cases.what: top 8 forwards, next 4 gameweeks, table with price and fixtures
turns: Top eight forwards by predicted points for the next four gameweeks, as a table with their prices and fixtures.
With £100m and no existing team, what's the best fifteen I could put together?
Captain choice for this gameweek: who should it be, and why?

cases.what: compare two named players, one flagged
turns: {p1} or {p2}: which one should I go for over the coming weeks?

cases.what: which of my players may rise / fall in price
turns: Will any of my players' prices move soon?

cases.what: swap preview then no -> 'No change made.', 0 writes
turns: Ditch {out8} for {in8}.
no

cases.what: swap preview then continue -> asks Yes / No, 0 writes; then yes -> saved once
turns: Transfer {in9} in for {out9}.
continue
yes

cases.what: General mode: best-value defenders under £5.0m, next 5 gameweeks
turns: Which sub-£5.0m defenders give the best value across the next five gameweeks?

set_c.what: misfire probe: two players, no comparison word -- both halves answered
turns: Is Salah fit, and when does Haaland play next?

set_c.what: misfire probe: two players, no comparison word -- answered, either route
turns: Tell me about Saka and Palmer.

set_c.what: misfire probe: 'or' with ONE player -- answered; the guard must not fire
turns: Should I keep Mbeumo or sell him?
Who's better value, Gabriel or Saliba?
What transfers should I make over the next five gameweeks?
Make two transfers for me this week.

fallbacks.rule: used in this fixed order only when a name does not have a single match, or its swap does not preview as legal, on the laptop database; the plan file records which was used and why. Case 6's fallbacks are flagged players, as p2 is.
